title: Context-aware role editor and membership wizard for RBAC v2
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: With RBAC v2 we need a role management UX that supports finer-grained permissions, SSO group mappings, temporary grants, and an auditable change surface that admins can reason about before saving. Current role editor patterns are either too coarse (single permission toggles) or too technical (raw JSON). We also need a member assignment flow that supports single-user invites, SSO group sync, and bulk operations while clearly surfacing audit implications and required approvals.

Goal: Design a role editor and membership wizard that: 1) Makes role scope and impact explicit (resource scope, allowed actions, constraints like time limits), 2) Integrates SSO/SAML group mapping and one-way group sync UX, 3) Shows an audit preview (what will be logged) and required reviewers/approvals for privileged grants, 4) Enables safe bulk membership changes with dry-run simulation and rollback, 5) Supports accessibility and compact mode for consoles with many roles.

High-level solution: A two-pane role editor with an intent-first left column (role metadata, scope selector, template pickers) and a right-hand live preview that shows "effective permissions" for example principals and the expected audit log entries for the change. Member assignment is surfaced through a stepper-style "membership wizard": 1) pick principals (users, SSO groups, service accounts), 2) choose assignment type (permanent, time-limited, delegated), 3) run a dry-run simulation that flags conflicts and existing overlapping permissions, 4) review audit entries and approval routes, 5) finalize.

Key UX patterns and components to design here:
- Scope selector (global / org / tenant / project) with visual inheritance map.
- Permission matrix with grouped actions, inline search, and quick-presets (read-only, viewer-plus, infra-admin).
- Time-limited grant control (start/end + timezone awareness + recommended durations for privileged grants).
- "Simulate impact" mode that shows effective permissions for a selected user or group and surfaces conflicts or escalation paths.
- SSO Group mapping card: allow mapping of provider groups to roles, toggle one-way sync, and preview mapped users (with counts) before commit.
- Audit preview panel that renders the exact event payload and human-friendly summary that will be sent to audit logs (who changed what, when, why).
- Safety guardrails: automatic soft-block for P0-level permissions requiring an approval workflow, and inline messaging to explain why an action is restricted.
- Membership bulk CSV import flow with preview, error rows and guided correction.
- Role templates library and import/export (JSON + CSV) for infra-as-code teams.
acceptance_criteria: Role editor UI available in console that allows creating/updating roles with: name, description, scope, permissions grouped by resource type, and time-limited grant options.
SSO group mapping card supporting mapping of at least one SAML/SCIM group to a role, with toggle for one-way sync and a preview of affected users.
Membership wizard supports single invite, bulk CSV import, and SSO-group assignments, with a dry-run simulation step that flags conflicts and overlapping grants.
Audit preview shows the human-friendly summary and the underlying audit payload. Changes requiring approval should route to the configured approvers and prevent direct commit without approval.
Accessibility: components pass keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, and color-contrast checks per WCAG 2.1 AA.
Design handoff artifacts (Figma prototypes, redlines, component tokens) provided and linked in ticket.
design_notes: Use live-preview pattern from Console's rollout editor to reduce WTF moments when admins change entitlements.
Emphasize 'example principal' preview — show how a user's effective access changes if role is saved. This reduces confusion around inherited permissions.
Prefer discrete, inline tooling for SSO mapping rather than redirecting to identity settings. Admins should be able to map groups during role creation.
Guardrails: For 'cluster-admin' style roles, require a two-step review. Add UI affordance for emergency bypass (logged and time-limited).
Export/Import: include schema version in exported role JSON to support future migrations from RBAC v1 to v2.
qa_test_cases: Create a role scoped to a single project and assign a time-limited grant; verify audit log entry contains start/end timestamps and timezone.
Map an SSO group to a role and verify that after sync the preview user count matches the identity provider's sample list.
Run a membership bulk import with deliberate duplicate rows and invalid emails and verify errors surface with row-level feedback.
Attempt to assign a P0 permission and confirm the UI blocks direct commit and creates an approval request to configured approvers.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Admin confusion about effective permissions when multiple roles overlap. Mitigation: invest in 'simulate impact' and example principals preview.
Risk: SSO sync could import more users than intended. Mitigation: preview mapped users with count limits and require explicit confirm for >100 users.
Risk: Audit payload might be misaligned with backend schema. Mitigation: collaborate with ENG for contract tests and include sample payloads in PRD.
